mapper.select: SELECT cu.id, cu.template_id AS templateId, ct.name, ct.type, ct.condition_amt AS conditionAmt, ct.discount_amt AS discountAmt, ct.discount_rate AS discountRate, ct.end_time AS endTime FROM coupon_user cu JOIN coupon_template ct ON cu.template_id = ct.id WHERE cu.user_id = #{userId} AND cu.status = '0' AND cu.del_flag = '0' AND ct.status = '1' AND ct.del_flag = '0' AND ct.start_time <= NOW() AND ct.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY ct.discount_amt DESC, ct.discount_rate DESC
